name: Toyooka Mie
source:
Hiroki's mother and a housewife. Her husband is currently working abroad. She joined mama club when it was introduced as the "mutual aid association" for her shy son. After learning the truth of the club, she wonders whether to leave or continue.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mmc3.html]official site[/url]]
